checkpointPayload.description: Show live construction/research queues and active marches from normalized RPC cache. Correct daily Tower, Arena/Grand Arena and Dungeon statuses, including today's attacks followed by no surviving eligible titans for any next door. Preserve unknown/stale states and distinguish exhausted daily runs from available actions.
checkpointPayload.title: Populate dashboard queues marches and daily completion states

newValue.text: Queue Status shows normalized live building and research data with correct time units and ready/idle/unknown states.
Active Marches shows gather, raid, monster and returning/battle marches with correct stage/countdowns and dialog links; expired returns disappear.
Daily activities mark fresh cleared Tower and exhausted Arena/Grand Arena done; Dungeon done only with same-day combat and every next door exhausted, retaining pending/unknown otherwise.
Dashboard reacts to cache/time changes; targeted behavior tests, typecheck and build pass.
